name: case-states
description: Closing and reopening a case follow from its data (2026-11-25, 26.12.01). Several status values can close a case. A change of status to one of them, by console or MCP update or by a submission, sets the closed date, records a Closed event that says who had the case, and takes them all off it. A case can be closed by the submission that creates it, and that is recorded too. Changing to another closed value changes nothing. Changing back to an open value reopens the case: the closed date is cleared, _case_reopened set, a Reopened event recorded, the people who had it get it back, its alerts can fire again timed from the reopening, and the case_reopened notification trigger fires. An imported closed case gets the same Closed entry (2026-11-25), and Operations record lists show how many times a case has reopened. Keeps its survey (with task_file on), a one minute case alert with no notifications, the records it makes and one notification, which sends to the cs_note question, whose answers are not addresses, so nothing is sent.

alert.name: Case states test - open 1 minute
alert.check: After the reopen step, wait until the record's history has an alert event later than the reopening (at most 4 minutes): the alert fired again, timed from the reopening, because reopening cleared it. It had fired before the case closed when the case was open for over a minute; if it had not, it must still fire only after the reopening plus the period.

import.note: Survey needs task_file on; each run adds one imported record

ops.expect: the test's open case reports reopened equal to the number of Reopened events in its history
